notes.title: Version 1.0.1
notes.content:
Update 1.0.1 notes:
Fixed pressure plate disconnecting on level reload

Updated last level message to be more concise

Fixed level 9-7 being trivial to solve

Fixed decomposer sometimes destroys a color during despawn

Fixed decomposer block shows up again on undo

Fixed pressure plate doesn't activate on undo if counter is at 0
